summary: LOT 3 (weekly family report + inactivity alert + share toggle) tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (share toggle owner/proche/non-owner, GET /famille share_progress, admin-only reports, weekly owners count excludes sharing-off and invited-only owners, inactivity alert once per absence across attempts/daily_attempts/palier_attempts and family_share_since fallback, no re-alert on 2nd call, active owner not alerted, curated palier start=20 questions for the 3 categories, /categories count=140). build_weekly_report called directly: days/games/escaping/html OK. Frontend: owner toggle -> toast 'Partage activé'/'Partage désactivé', persists after reload; proche sees correct ON/OFF text and no toggle. Backend starts cleanly (curated sync + _safe_index logs OK, no crash). All test users/activity cleaned up.

minor.issue: Curated questions have no discussion_prompt (annees-80: 0/140, annees-2010: 0/140, bien-vieillir: 8/239). Owner playing only those categories always gets the hard-coded fallback 'Quel est votre plus beau souvenir de vacances ?' instead of a real prompt. Verified via build_weekly_report with annees-80/annees-2010 activity. Fix: if category-filtered $sample is empty, retry without category filter (and/or add discussion_prompt to curated JSON).

family_inactivity_alert_for marker is set even when every send fails (sent=0, e.g. Resend error), so the alert is lost for good for that absence period. Consider setting marker only if at least one email sent.
Does not check is_family_owner(owner): an owner whose premium/famille plan expired but kept family_share_progress=True still triggers reports/alerts to proches. Add is_family_owner filter.

Contains 239 questions (paliers 1:20, 2:20, 3:22, 4:42, 5:48, 6:47, 7:40), not 140 as stated; GET /api/categories still reports count=140 for bien-vieillir while DB has 239. Check whether the extra items are intended or whether the category count is stale.
Log still says '13 jobs actifs' and the listing omits the new family_inactivity_alert (11:00) and family_weekly_report_sunday (dim 10:00) jobs; cosmetic but misleading.

No per-owner try/except: one malformed created_at (e.g. naive datetime string or datetime object) would raise and abort the whole batch for all owners. Current data is all tz-aware ISO strings, so this is not a problem today.

issues: When the toggle is OFF the owner text still says 'Chaque dimanche, vos proches reçoivent...' as if it were active. Consider a different wording for OFF ('Activez pour que vos proches reçoivent...').
Switch is not disabled while the PUT request runs, so a fast double-click can send two requests (minor).

Only set family_inactivity_alert_for when at least one email was actually sent
Check bien-vieillir curated JSON size (239 vs 140) and category count
Update the scheduler startup log line to include the 2 new family jobs
